description: Accelerated backend development by 5x for banking back-office application, rapidly delivering RESTful endpoints using Java Spring Boot within tight deadlines after project cancellation in an Agile/SCRUM environment.

Eliminated technical debt and improved code quality by 60% by implementing TDD practices, writing 200+ unit tests, and resolving 150+ SonarQube code smells across the codebase, maintaining zero technical debt throughout development cycle.

Demonstrated rapid onboarding capabilities by achieving full integration into development team within 30 days through comprehensive documentation review and proactive contribution beyond intern-level responsibilities.

Reduced order fulfillment cycle time by 90% by architecting and deploying a custom end-to-end CRM and product configurator application using Java Spring Boot backend and React frontend, automating quote generation, order processing, and manufacturing workflows.
Cut infrastructure costs by 93% and improved system scalability by migrating web applications and domain servers to AWS cloud infrastructure.

Executed microservices migration from legacy monolithic application, refactoring Java backend services and React frontend components to distributed architecture while maintaining 100% feature parity for high-traffic application serving 25,000 requests per minute

Collaborated cross-functionally in Agile/Scrum environment with development teams, product owners, and QA engineers to deliver sprint commitments and maintain continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Performed root cause analysis and resolved critical production issues in enterprise-scale codebase, improving system reliability.
